description.zh: VPC实例连接的云企业网实例的ID。
description.en: The ID of the CEN instance to which the VPC is connected.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围：10~500。

默认值：
- 当不设置值时，默认值为20。
- 当设置的值大于500时，默认值为500。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default value:

- If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 20.

- If you specify a value greater than 500, the default value is 500.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值。
description.en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

- If this is your first query, you do not need to specify this parameter.

- If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value that was returned from the last call.
The primary private IPv4 address of the ENI.

description.zh:
VPC实例下的一个交换机ID。

一次仅支持查询一个交换机下的弹性网卡的信息。
description.en:
The ID of a vSwitch in the VPC.

You can query information about the ENIs in only one vSwitch at a time.

title.zh: 查询专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）下可以成为组播源或者组播成员的弹性网卡的信息

descriptions.zh: 调用`ListGrantVSwitchEnis`接口前，请确保VPC实例已被连接至云企业网。具体操作，请参见[CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment](~~261358~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you call the `ListGrantVSwitchEnis` operation, make sure that the VPC is connected to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance. For more information, see [CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment](~~261358~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn list-grant-vswitch-enis --cen-id cen-a7syd349kne38g0000 --vpc-id vpc-p0w9alkte4w2htrqe0000 --vswitch-id vsw-p0w9s2ig1jnwgrbzl0000 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 20 --network-interface-id eni-wz9a2sgsskvw69v20000 --network-interface-name test-eni-name --primary-ip-address 192.168.00.00 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn ListGrantVSwitchEnis --region cn-hangzhou --VpcId 'vpc-p0w9alkte4w2htrqe0000' --NextToken AAAAAdDWBF20000 --NetworkInterfaceId.1 'eni-wz9a2sgsskvw69v20000' --VSwitchId 'vsw-p0w9s2ig1jnwgrbzl0000' --MaxResults 20 --CenId 'cen-a7syd349kne38g0000' --NetworkInterfaceName 'test-eni-name' --PrimaryIpAddress '192.168.00.00' --method POST --force
